name: forth_trace
paper_title: A benchmark study on feature selection for human activity recognition
authors: Katerina Karagiannaki, Athanasia Panousopoulou, Panagiotis Tsakalides
venue: UbiComp/ISWC '16 Adjunct: Proceedings of the 2016 ACM International Joint Conference on Pervasive and Ubiquitous Computing: Adjunct, 105-108
license: Dataset: cite the UbiComp 2016 paper (per the repository README). Paper PDF from the authors' institutional page at ICS-FORTH.
notes: 15 participants x 5 Shimmer nodes (left wrist, right wrist, torso, right thigh, left ankle) x 16 activities (7 basic + 9 postural transitions). CODE-VS-DOC: the repository README documents the 12-column layout (device id, acc xyz, gyro xyz, mag xyz, timestamp, activity label) and 51.2 Hz; both verified. TWO THINGS THE README DOES NOT SAY, both measured: (1) the gyroscope is in DEG/S -- walking p99 is about 130 and the dataset max p99.9 is 425.7 deg/s, so the converter converts to rad/s; (2) the millisecond timestamps lose precision late in each file, so the converter uses gap-aware row placement on the documented 51.2 Hz clock. Gap-aware alignment retains 14 of 15 participants at >=0.84 node-label agreement. Part8's earlier 0.13 score was caused by interpolating across a 1,828 s dropout and becomes 0.974 after the gap is split. Only part4 is excluded: its five annotation tracks remain at 0.147 agreement and describe different takes.
